concept.heading: Core Pattern
concept.body: Backtracking = DFS + undo. Make a choice, recurse, undo the choice. Template:

problems.title: Subsets
problems.keyInsight: For each element, two choices: include it or skip it. Or iterate starting from index i+1 to avoid duplicates.

problems.title: Combination Sum
problems.keyInsight: Same as subsets but can reuse elements (start from i, not i+1). Stop when sum > target.

problems.title: Permutations
problems.keyInsight: Unlike subsets, order matters. Track used elements. At each position, try all unused elements.

problems.title: Subsets II
problems.keyInsight: Sort first, then skip duplicates at the same level: if nums[i] == nums[i-1] and i > start, skip.

problems.title: Combination Sum II
problems.keyInsight: Like Combination Sum but each number used once (i+1) + skip duplicates (sort + skip same level).

code.python:
def combinationSum2(candidates, target):
    candidates.sort()
    result = []
    def backtrack(start, path, total):
        if total == target:
            result.append(path[:])
            return
        for i in range(start, len(candidates)):
            if total + candidates[i] > target: break
            if i > start and candidates[i] == candidates[i-1]: continue
            path.append(candidates[i])
            backtrack(i + 1, path, total + candidates[i])
            path.pop()
    backtrack(0, [], 0)
    return result

problems.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
N-Queens
problems.keyInsight: Place queens row by row. Track attacked columns, positive diagonals (r+c), negative diagonals (r-c) using sets.

code.python:
def solveNQueens(n):
    result = []
    cols, pos_diag, neg_diag = set(), set(), set()
    board = [["."]*n for _ in range(n)]

    def backtrack(row):
        if row == n:
            result.append(["".join(r) for r in board])
            return
        for col in range(n):
            if col in cols or (row+col) in pos_diag or (row-col) in neg_diag:
                continue
            cols.add(col); pos_diag.add(row+col); neg_diag.add(row-col)
            board[row][col] = "Q"
            backtrack(row + 1)
            cols.discard(col); pos_diag.discard(row+col); neg_diag.discard(row-col)
            board[row][col] = "."
    backtrack(0)
    return result
